philosophical_theme: CLUSTER: Metaphysical hierarchy — Unity > Being > Good > Intellect > Soul > Body > Virtues
plotinian_parallel: Enneads throughout (esp. 6.7–6.9 on the virtues; 1.2–1.8 on virtue classification)
charge: Union (henosis) with the One potentially denies individual soul's distinction and personal immortality.
defense: Mystical union understood as participation, not absorption. Soul retains identity while participating in divine perfection. Cites Plotinus and Dionysian mysticism.
notes: T6–T20 likely constitute a coherent metaphysical cluster. Each conclusion probably refines the ontological hierarchy. Pico cites Plotinus, Porphyry, and Ficino heavily. Check Allen's systematic treatment in *Neoplatonism and the Platonic Tradition*.

_sourcing.theme: Henosis and Union with the Good

exegesis: Pico's conclusion on The One within the Neoplatonism tradition.
